summary: Remotion is a framework for creating videos programmatically using React.
It leverages web technologies, programming, and React to create reusable components and powerful composition.
Remotion can be used to create high-quality videos with various effects such as CSS, Canvas, SVG, and WebGL.
The project requires a company license in some cases due to its special licensing terms.
Contributing to the project is allowed, but please read the CONTRIBUTING.md file for more information.
VibeVoice is a family of open-source frontier voice AI models that includes both Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models.
The VibeVoice-TTS model can synthesize speech up to 90 minutes long with up to 4 distinct speakers.
VibeVoice-Streaming is a lightweight real-time text-to-speech model supporting streaming text input and robust long-form speech generation.
The VibeVoice ASR model jointly performs ASR, diarization, and timestamping, producing a structured output that indicates who said what and when.
VibeVoice models are intended for research and development purposes only and should not be used in commercial or real-world applications without further testing and development.
goose is an open-source, extensible AI agent that automates engineering tasks
it works with any LLM and supports multi-model configuration to optimize performance and cost
goose can build entire projects from scratch, write and execute code, debug failures, orchestrate workflows, and interact with external APIs autonomously
it is designed for maximum flexibility and seamlessly integrates with MCP servers
goose is available as both a desktop app and CLI
